_provenance.why: Best DR-carrying UR3Pick run to date (eval/episode_success = 0.930). Every key below is copied from that run's recorded W&B config, NOT hand-written -- see the Planfile '20260814_Saturating reward - sweep exploration' WP1.

inherited_env_defaults.note: The source run sets NO init keys at all, so these are whatever ur3_pick.default_config() gives. Recorded here so the sweep is reproducible if a default ever moves; NOT re-specified above, because re-specifying would silently pin values the reference run never pinned.

init_start_random_is_a_pose_LIBRARY_not_.what: 'mid' is a LEVEL NAME selecting a set of starting positions, not a difficulty scalar. ur3_pick.py:870-873 does load_init_poses(level, 'train') -> init_poses/train/mid.json, and reset() draws ONE pose per episode out of that library. The levels are 'light'/'mid'/'hard' (plus 'none' = legacy keyframe start); each is its own file.
init_start_random_is_a_pose_LIBRARY_not_.provenance_of_the_poses: Hand-collected on the real UR3e via RTDE getActualQ (60 s freedrive capture, one sample every 2 s), per the file's own metadata. These are recorded real robot poses, not sampled numbers.
init_start_random_is_a_pose_LIBRARY_not_.WARNING_the_library_changed_after_the_re: init_poses/train/mid.json was REPLACED on 2026-07-29 in commit bb35de8 ('new mid trainingset and eval Position set'), which is AFTER RealDR_vel_as04_gas02_s0 trained on 2026-07-27 (it used the 2026-07-01 version from 2f48588). Pose count went 30 -> 60. Verified purely ADDITIVE: all 30 original poses are retained inside the new 60, none dropped.
init_start_random_is_a_pose_LIBRARY_not_.consequence_for_this_sweep: Cell a0b0c0d0 reproduces the reference run's PPO HYPERPARAMETERS but NOT its init distribution -- it trains on a 2x wider pose library. So a0b0c0d0 landing below the reference's 0.930 is not by itself evidence of a regression. Rank the 16 cells AGAINST EACH OTHER; treat 0.930 as an external reference, not a directly comparable control.
init_start_random_is_a_pose_LIBRARY_not_.why_metadata_cannot_save_you: The two versions carry BYTE-IDENTICAL metadata -- same 'created': '2026-06-26T16:17:00', same seed, same capture block. Only len(poses) (30 vs 60) distinguishes them, so a policy's metadata cannot tell you which library it trained on.

forced_deviations.episode_length: 400 -- already set by the source run; env default is 250, so it is pinned explicitly.
forced_deviations.box_z_rot_range: 6.283185307179586 -- the source run did NOT set it and inherited the env default 6.28319. Pinned here at full 2*pi precision so the value lands in every run config and the regression guard can see it.
forced_deviations.obs_include_velocity: true -- already set by the source run; env default is false, so it is pinned explicitly.

_provenance.reward_weights: Deliberately absent. No reward_config / reward-term key appears here or in any generated sweep line -- the value function is given and only PPO knobs move.
